Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz stated on Tuesday that political narratives and criticism possess a limited shelf life, emphasizing that tangible public service and development dictate electoral success. Speaking at a Honhaar Scholarship and laptop distribution event at Government Comprehensive High School in Jhelum, Maryam argued that voters judge political parties by their development records rather than rhetorical claims. She pointed to PML-N's recent local election victories in Sahiwal and Gujranwala as proof of public backing despite combined opposition efforts.

Addressing recent allegations of corruption leveled by federal minister Chaudhry Salik Hussain, Maryam questioned why critics do not resign from the cabinet if they genuinely suspect wrongdoing. She maintained that trillions of rupees spent on development projects over the past three years were free of corruption, though she clarified she never claimed corruption had completely vanished from the province. She also announced extensive regional initiatives, including the expansion of the Green Bus service, the establishment of Nawaz Sharif Schools of Eminence starting in Jhelum on December 15, and cardiac treatment and cancer hospital projects across multiple cities.

The remarks arrive amid heightened political commentary regarding Salik's claims and subsequent defenses. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif previously asserted that Salik's statements were part of a broader push to establish an alternative political arrangement in Pakistan. Salik, a PML-Q leader, had criticized provincial administration spending and government aircraft usage during a televised interview, maintaining that he stood entirely by his honest assessment of administrative issues.

Tensions between provincial leadership and allied political factions have highlighted underlying fractures following the 2022 ouster of Imran Khan. While Salik's family remains aligned with the Sharifs, internal frictions persist over local appointments and policy decisions, such as the recent transfer of the Gujrat deputy commissioner. CM Maryam reiterated that her administration remains fully transparent, answerable to the public, and dedicated to expanding infrastructure evenly across all regional divisions.

stories.title: Met Office Forecasts Rainfall and Snowfall Across Pakistan from Tuesday
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Meteorological Department has announced that a shallow westerly wave is approaching the western and northern regions of the country, expected to strengthen by November 12 and persist in upper areas until November 14. This incoming weather system is projected to bring rainfall, isolated heavy falls, and hailstorms to Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa, Kashmir, and Gilgit-Baltistan between November 10 and November 14. Mountainous areas within these regions may also experience snowfall during the forecast period.

In addition to northern weather activity, light rain accompanied by wind and thunderstorms is expected in Islamabad, the Potohar region, Murree, Galliyat, and surrounding areas. Various districts across Punjab will likely see rainfall on November 12 and 13, with specific rain-wind and thunderstorm activity hitting Dera Ghazi Khan, Layyah, Bhakkar, and Multan on November 12 alongside isolated hailstorms. Daytime temperatures are projected to drop by two to four degrees Celsius throughout the duration of the weather system.

Meanwhile, mostly dry weather is forecasted to prevail across Balochistan, although isolated rain, wind, thunderstorms, and hailstorms are expected in Zhob, Barkhan, Musakhel, Quetta, Ziarat, Chaman, Qila Abdullah, Qila Saifullah, Kalat, and Khuzdar on the night of November 11 and into November 12. These meteorological changes mark a notable shift in weather patterns across multiple provinces.

The updated weather advisory serves to alert local populations, travelers, and agricultural communities in the affected regions to prepare for sudden temperature drops and potential precipitation-related disruptions. Authorities in the designated zones are monitoring the system as it intensifies through the middle of the week.

stories.title: Pakistan Gold Prices Drop Following International Market Declines
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a downward adjustment on Tuesday, following a corresponding drop in the global market. According to rates provided by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association, the price of gold per tola decreased by Rs1,500 to rest at Rs430,836 in the local market.

Similarly, the price for 10 grams of gold fell by Rs1,286, bringing it to a domestic selling price of Rs369,372. These decreases come immediately after a previous session on Monday, during which the tola price had risen by Rs3,200 to reach Rs432,336.

Internationally, the price of gold decreased by $15, settling at $4,083 per ounce. Meanwhile, the domestic market rate for silver remained stable, holding steady at Rs5,723 per tola.

stories.title: Ousted Bangladeshi Leader Sheikh Hasina Faces Execution Upon Return
stories.summary:
Bangladesh’s ousted leader Sheikh Hasina will face execution if she returns to the country, according to the prosecutor who secured her death sentence. Hasina, whose 15-year rule concluded following a mass uprising in 2024, has publicly stated her intention to return home in December. Md Aminul Islam, the prosecutor, stated that the 79-year-old former prime minister has exhausted her legal options because the statutory appeal period has expired without any filings.

Following a violent student-led uprising in 2024 that resulted in up to 1,400 deaths according to United Nations estimates, Hasina fled to India by helicopter. In November 2025, a Dhaka court convicted her in absentia on three counts of crimes against humanity, including incitement, ordering killings, and failing to prevent atrocities, sentencing her to death. While Bangladesh's foreign ministry has requested her extradition from India, her planned return poses a major political challenge for Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s administration.

Hasina has defended her planned return by asserting that fear cannot dictate her duty to the people, despite being fully aware of the death sentence she faces. Her prospective homecoming has created deep political divisions, with many citizens demanding her execution while others fear it could incite renewed conflict between rival political camps.

Tensions surrounding her loyalists have already surfaced, with police recently arresting 12 members of her banned Awami League party for involvement in a series of petrol bomb attacks targeting buses, property, and police vehicles. Meanwhile, Hasina's legal team has requested a passport renewal, though legal authorities have indicated that individuals convicted of serious crimes may be denied travel documents.

stories.title: سپین میں عوامی مقامات پر بوس و کنار کی روایت اور ثقافتی پس منظر
stories.summary:
سپین میں عوامی مقامات پر جوڑوں کا ایک دوسرے کو بوسہ دینا اور محبت کا اظہار کرنا ایک عام بات ہے۔ یہ عمل وہاں کے روزمرہ کے معمولات کا حصہ سمجھا جاتا ہے، جہاں لوگ سڑکوں، پارکوں اور کیفے جیسے عوامی مقامات پر زیادہ وقت گزارتے ہیں اور اپنے جذبات کا اظہار کرنے میں کسی قسم کی ہچکچاہٹ محسوس نہیں کرتے۔

اس رجحان کی ایک بڑی وجہ سپین میں رہائشی مسائل بھی ہیں۔ اعداد و شمار کے مطابق ملک کی تقریباً 65 فیصد آبادی فلیٹس میں رہتی ہے، جو یورپی یونین میں سب سے زیادہ شرح ہے۔ مکانات کی بلند قیمتوں کی وجہ سے نوجوانوں کے لیے اپنے والدین کا گھر چھوڑنا مشکل ہو چکا ہے، جس کے باعث وہ نجی لمحات کے لیے عوامی جگہوں کا رخ کرنے پر مجبور ہوتے ہیں۔

تاہم، ماہرین کا ماننا ہے کہ اس کی اصل وجہ سپین کا بے تکلف اور جذبات کُھل کر ظاہر کرنے والا ثقافتی رویہ ہے۔ شمالی یورپی ممالک کے برعکس یہاں کے لوگ سماجی طور پر زیادہ قریب رہتے ہیں اور ایک دوسرے کے ساتھ جسمانی قربت جلدی اختیار کر لیتے ہیں، جو اس معاشرتی رویے کو تقویت دیتا ہے۔

ماضی میں فرانکو کی آمریت (1939-1975) کے دوران عوامی سطح پر محبت کے اظہار پر سخت پابندیاں تھیں اور بوسہ لینے پر جرمانے بھی کیے جاتے تھے۔ لیکن 1975 کے بعد آنے والی ثقافتی تبدیلیوں اور عوامی تحریکوں بالخصوص احتجاجی مظاہروں نے اس ماحول کو بدل دیا، جس کے بعد 1988 میں عوامی بے حیائی کا قانون بھی ختم کر دیا گیا تھا۔

stories.title: Warehouse Fire Breaks Out on Karachi’s M.A. Jinnah Road
stories.summary:
A fire erupted inside a warehouse situated at Prime Centre, near Rimpa Plaza on M.A. Jinnah Road in Karachi. The blaze began in a vehicle spare parts shop located on the ground and first floors of the building, generating heavy smoke that spread throughout the surrounding market area. Security personnel from both the police and Rangers responded to the scene to assist with emergency operations. Three fire brigade vehicles were deployed to battle the flames.

This incident follows a previous fire on October 30 at a furniture market located near Kamran Chowrangi in Karachi's Gulistan-e-Jauhar area. Chief Fire Officer Humayun Khan stated that the earlier blaze was successfully brought under control using four fire tenders and a water bowser, with no casualties reported. The furniture market, which sits on a commercial plot and consists of twenty shops, had experienced a fire previously.

Shopkeeper Asghar noted that the market participants initially contacted Rescue 15 regarding the Gulistan-e-Jauhar fire. According to Asghar, helpline operators promised to notify the fire department, but fire tenders did not arrive until fifteen to twenty minutes later, allowing the fire ample time to spread. He estimated that the damage from that incident totaled millions of rupees.

These ongoing fire incidents highlight recurring urban safety challenges in Karachi's commercial sectors. Prompt emergency responses remain vital to mitigating property losses and safeguarding densely populated commercial zones across the city.

stories.title: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Departs for COP31 Summit in Turkiye
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif left for Antalya, Turkiye, on Tuesday to attend the Leaders' Summit of the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change. The prime minister is scheduled to address the summit on November 11, urging concrete international action against climate threats while highlighting Pakistan's expansion of renewable energy and disaster preparedness systems.

Accompanied by PPP leader Sherry Rehman, Information Minister Ataullah Tarar, and adviser Tariq Fatemi, the premier will also advocate for accessible climate finance for developing nations. During the November 10-12 visit, he plans to participate in a high-level roundtable and hold bilateral talks with the Turkish leadership and other world leaders.

His attendance underscores Islamabad's commitment to the global climate agenda and international cooperation. The summit comes amid severe global weather extremes and ongoing debates over financial support from developed countries to help poorer nations adapt to climate impacts.

Negotiations at the event have faced a difficult start due to disputes over including climate finance items on the official agenda. Meanwhile, recent reports indicate that global temperatures continue to rise, threatening to breach ambitious thresholds set by the Paris Agreement.

stories.title: Pakistan Declares First Innings at 434-9 Against Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi Test
stories.summary:
Pakistan declared their first innings at 434 for nine on the second day of the opening Test against Sri Lanka at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Tuesday. Resuming their innings at 281 for five, the hosts added 153 runs in the morning and afternoon sessions before making the declaration in the afternoon.

Overnight batter Saud Shakeel narrowly missed a century, getting dismissed for 93 runs off 199 deliveries after edging an Asitha Fernando delivery to wicket-keeper Kusal Mendis. Debutant Ghazi Ghori contributed a solid 48 runs from 72 balls, while another debutant, Arafat Minhas, added a valuable half-century by scoring 52 runs off 72 deliveries.

The partnership between Saud and Ghazi yielded 96 runs, frustrating the visiting seam attack and pushing Pakistan past the 300-run mark. Sri Lankan bowlers Asitha Fernando and Dilshan Madushanka finished the innings with three wickets each, leaving Sri Lanka to begin their reply with a substantial deficit.

The strong total follows a resilient opening day performance where Pakistan recovered from early setbacks, bolstered by half-centuries from Azan Awais, Tayyab Arif, Babar Azam, and Mohammad Taha before Saud took control of the innings.

stories.title: Trump Says Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Did Not Know Lover Was Alleged Chinese Spy
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated on Monday that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had no idea that a woman he had an affair with was an alleged Chinese spy. Trump mentioned that he spoke with the chip boss earlier in the day to check on him, describing Huang as an amazing person who is currently suffering greatly, particularly for the sake of his family.

Jensen Huang publicly addressed the situation on Sunday by sending a message to Nvidia employees in which he acknowledged the affair and apologized to his family and staff. The controversy involves Alice Huang, a Chinese executive accused of funnels information to Beijing. Trump stated he was unaware of the allegations when Huang accompanied him to China in May.

Although Huang has frequently attended White House events, including a state visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping in September, Trump declined to specify when he was personally informed about the intelligence linking the tech executive to the spying allegations.

When asked by reporters about a potential investigation, Trump expressed confidence that Huang would be in good shape while noting the FBI is looking into the matter. The FBI declined to comment when asked to clarify whether an official investigation into Huang is currently underway.

stories.title: Rawalpindi Court Grants Four-Day Physical Remand of Accused in Rabia Ahsan Murder Case
stories.summary:
A local court in Rawalpindi has granted a four-day physical remand of the accused, Ahsan, to the police for further investigation into the murder of anchorperson Rabia Ahsan. Civil Judge Muhammad Nasrullah Wattoo approved the police request, handing the accused over to the Sadar Beruni Police.

According to preliminary statements from a domestic worker, the household was organizing summer clothes and taking out winter wear when a .30-bore pistol was found among the garments. The worker stated that Ahsan picked up the weapon, waved it, and a shot was fired accidentally. Police noted that no ongoing argument or dispute between the couple has been identified so far.

The initial post-mortem report indicates that Rabia Ahsan died after a bullet struck the lower part of her front neck. Investigators also revealed that the recovered firearm was unlicensed, and further actions will be taken once forensic laboratory reports are finalized.

stories.title: North Waziristan Matric Exams Postponed Amid Security Measures
stories.summary:
The Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education in Bannu announced the postponement of the Secondary School Certificate Second Annual Examination in North Waziristan. Released on November 9, the directive followed instructions from the North Waziristan deputy commissioner due to prevailing security conditions. A revised timetable for the affected tests will be issued later, though exams at centers established in Bakakhel tehsil and Cadet College Razmak will proceed according to the original plan.

This marks the second time these examinations, initially scheduled to begin on October 12, have been delayed in North Waziristan. They were previously postponed alongside exams in Bannu and Lakki Marwat. Concurrently, district authorities imposed a curfew spanning from Bobali and Mir Ali up to Isha. The restriction will remain active until ongoing security operations conclude, and the Bannu-Miranshah Road is closed to all traffic during this period.

Malik Rohullah Khan, an area representative and Development Council member, explained that the general officer commanding north ordered the curfew. However, following his appeal, residents gained permission to visit markets in Miranshah and Datta Khel to acquire essential daily items. Individuals seeking to travel outside North Waziristan are permitted to utilize the Razmak, Isha, and Miranshah routes.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa continues to navigate persistent security hurdles. Recently, military media reported that security forces neutralized two terrorist hideouts inside mosques in Muzak village, recovering improvised explosive devices, weapons, and ammunition. Meanwhile, statistics from the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies noted that terrorist attacks in the province decreased by 31 percent in October compared to September.

stories.title: How Russia's G8 Exit Exposed the Limits of Global Governance
stories.summary:
The 52nd G7 Summit held in Évian-les-Bains, France, refocused diplomatic attention on the historical evolution of the Group of Seven and the removal of Russia, which transformed the bloc into the G8 for nearly two decades. Established originally in 1975 to address oil shocks and stagflation, the forum expanded to include Canada and later integrated Russia in 1997 to foster cooperation after the Cold War. Moscow's entry aimed to anchor Russia within a Euro-Atlantic framework, aligning global powers beyond pure economic parity.

Fundamental differences regarding security interests and a Western-defined rules-based order ultimately strained relations. The diplomatic breaking point occurred in 2014 during the Ukraine crisis when Russia incorporated Crimea following a local referendum. In response, G7 leaders cancelled the planned summit in Sochi and excluded Russia, effectively ending the G8 format without a formal charter or expulsion mechanism. Critics argue this exclusion reflected geopolitical power dynamics rather than consistent adherence to international legal principles.

Observers point out that Western powers have historically engaged in military interventions, regime changes, and coercive campaigns—such as actions in Panama, Kosovo, Iraq, Iran, and Venezuela—without facing suspension or similar institutional penalties. This selective enforcement has fueled skepticism across the Global South regarding the neutrality of international bodies, leading many governments to view rules through the lens of unequal application rather than universal justice.

The global landscape of 2026 features rising powers like China and India alongside active participation from nations demanding a greater voice in international affairs. Russia's departure from the premier diplomatic club underscored the fragility of post-Cold War integration visions. Ultimately, the episode demonstrates that exclusive international institutions risk eroding their moral authority when principles are applied selectively to rivals while allies are accommodated.

stories.title: سب انسپکٹر ہلاکت کیس: بلوچستان ہائی کورٹ نے سابق ایم پی اے عبدالمجید اچکزئی کو سزا سنا دی
stories.summary:
بلوچستان ہائی کورٹ نے سب انسپکٹر عطاء اللّٰہ کی ہلاکت کے مقدمے میں سابق رکن صوبائی اسمبلی (ایم پی اے) عبدالمجید اچکزئی کو 10 سال قید بامشقت کی سزا سنا دی ہے۔ عدالت نے ملزم پر 10 لاکھ روپے جرمانہ عائد کرنے کا بھی حکم دیا ہے۔

عدالت نے 2020ء میں سنائے گئے عبدالمجید اچکزئی کی بریت کے فیصلے کو کالعدم قرار دے دیا۔ سابقہ سیشن کورٹ کے تفصیلی فیصلے میں کہا گیا تھا کہ پراسیکیوشن کے پاس ملزم کے خلاف کافی ثبوت نہیں تھے اور گواہوں نے تصدیق نہیں کی تھی کہ گاڑی ملزم خود چلا رہا تھا۔

جسٹس محمد عامر نواز رانا اور جسٹس عبدالقیوم لہڑی پر مشتمل دو رکنی بینچ نے یہ فیصلہ سنایا۔ عدالت نے سابق ایم پی اے کو مقتول کے ورثاء کو دیت کی رقم ادا کرنے کا بھی حکم جاری کیا ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ، عدالت نے عبدالمجید اچکزئی کے ناقابل ضمانت وارنٹ جاری کرنے کی ہدایت کرتے ہوئے انھیں فوری طور پر گرفتار کر کے جیل منتقل کرنے کا حکم دیا ہے۔ کیس کی سماعت کے دوران متعلقہ قانونی کارروائی عمل میں لائی گئی۔

stories.title: بلوچستان کے ضلع لسبیلہ میں 20 کروڑ روپے کی ڈکیتی کا انکشاف
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے صوبہ بلوچستان کے ضلع لسبیلہ کے علاقے اوتھل میں 28 فروری 2025 کو ایک نجی بینک میں 20 کروڑ 20 لاکھ روپے کی بڑی ڈکیتی کی واردات پیش آئی تھی۔ بینک مینیجر فلک شیر کی مدعیت میں درج ایف آئی آر کے مطابق چھ ملزمان سکیورٹی فورسز کی وردی سے مشابہ لباس پہن کر گاڑی میں سوار ہو کر بینک کے اندر داخل ہوئے تھے۔ ملزمان نے عملے کو یرغمال بنایا، مزاحمت کرنے پر پولیس اہلکاروں کو زخمی کیا اور نقدی چھ بوریوں میں بھر کر فرار ہو گئے۔

پولیس کے مطابق اس ڈکیتی کی منصوبہ بندی ایک ماہ تک کی گئی تھی اور اس میں ملوث افراد میں لسبیلہ یونیورسٹی آف میرین سائنسز کے موجودہ اور سابق طلب علم شامل تھے۔ مرکزی ملزم سمیت تین ملزمان کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا ہے جبکہ دیگر کی تلاش جاری ہے۔ گرفتار ملزم بلال حمید نے پریس کانفرنس میں جرم کا اعتراف کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ وہ تربت کے ایک بینک میں کیشیئر کے طور پر کام کر چکا تھا، جس کی وجہ سے اسے بینک کی اندرونی معلومات حاصل تھیں اور اسی بنیاد پر یہ منصوبہ بنایا گیا۔

واردات کے بعد فرار ہونے والے ملزمان کا تعاقب کرنے والے اوتھل کے اس وقت کے ایس ایچ او یار محمد فائرنگ کے تبادلے میں شدید زخمی ہو گئے جن کی ایک آنکھ ضائع ہو گئی۔ پولیس کے مطابق ملزمان نے اپنی شناخت چھپانے اور شواہد مٹانے کے لیے فرار کے دوران استعمال ہونے والی گاڑی اور ہتھیاروں کو پہاڑی علاقے میں آگ لگا کر جلا دیا تھا تاکہ فنگر پرنٹس نہ مل سکیں۔

تفتیش کے دوران پولیس کو اہم سراغ مرکزی ملزم کے بینک اکاؤنٹ سے ملا جہاں واردات کے بعد کروڑوں روپے کی ٹرانزیکشنز ہوئیں۔ ایس ایس پی لسبیلہ نجیب اللہ پندرانی کے مطابق ملزمان کی عمریں 25 سے 26 سال کے درمیان ہیں اور پولیس اس سنگین کیس میں مفرور دیگر ملزمان کی گرفتاری کے لیے مسلسل چھاپے مار رہی ہے تاکہ قانون کے مطابق کارروائی عمل میں لائی جا سکے۔

stories.title: PIA Mandates Employee Disclosure Forms to Identify Potential Conflicts of Interest
stories.summary:
The new management of Pakistan International Airlines has introduced a mandatory directive requiring all employees to submit formal disclosure forms. This measure aims to pinpoint potential conflicts of interest within the national carrier and enhance overall organisational transparency for the airline's operations.

Under the updated rules, staff members must report close relatives currently employed by the airline, including parents, siblings, and spouses. Employees are additionally obligated to disclose connections with third-party vendors, outsourced personnel, and individuals linked to PIA's business partners, suppliers, and contractors. Personnel must also inform management if any of their relatives maintain separate business interests involving the national carrier.

To address privacy concerns, PIA management assured staff that all submitted disclosure data will be handled with strict confidentiality, limiting access exclusively to authorised officials. However, the directive outlines stern warnings that employees who furnish false details, conceal relevant relationships, or fail to complete the forms by the deadline will face severe disciplinary action. Employees were given a final deadline of November 10 to submit the required documentation.

The implementation of these transparency measures coincides with recent corporate milestones for the airline, such as the arrival of its first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner. Management hopes the disclosure policy will safeguard the integrity of the organisation as it navigates structural and operational developments.

stories.title: Trump Says Nvidia CEO Had No Knowledge Lover Was Alleged Chinese Spy
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had no idea that a woman he maintained a relationship with was an alleged Chinese spy. Speaking at the White House, Trump described the Taiwanese-born tech executive as an amazing person and mentioned that he spoke with Huang to check on his well-being, noting that the CEO is suffering greatly over the situation, particularly regarding his family and wife.

Trump declined to specify when he personally became aware of intelligence linking Huang to Alice Huang, a Chinese executive accused of funnelling information to Beijing. When asked if he knew about the allegations in May when the tech boss accompanied him to China, Trump indicated he was unaware at the time, though he noted many people are now talking about the matter. Trump stated that he believes Huang's assertion that he was completely unaware of the spying allegations.

Jensen Huang recently addressed the issue by sending a message to Nvidia employees in which he admitted to the affair and apologised to both his family and the company staff. The CEO has previously participated in numerous prominent White House events, including a state visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping in September, given his central role in the artificial intelligence sector.

When questioned by reporters regarding whether an active federal investigation into Huang has been launched, the Federal Bureau of Investigation declined to comment. Trump remarked that the FBI is likely looking into related aspects of the situation, expressing confidence that the tech executive will ultimately be in good shape.

stories.title: France vows strong measures against Iran over supermarket cyberattack
stories.summary:
France has stated it rules out nothing in response to a major cyberattack targeting hundreds of supermarket refrigeration systems in October. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot announced that Paris is blaming Iran for the incident, which marked the first large-scale cyber sabotage on French territory. 

Speaking to FranceinfoTV, Barrot revealed that the Iranian ambassador will be summoned and European-level sanctions will be pursued. He emphasized that France will implement proportionate and necessary measures, including undisclosed actions, to deter similar future attacks. Barrot previously attributed the sabotage to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) during a G7 foreign ministers' meeting in Paris, noting the unprecedented scale and aggression of the breach.

The October 11 and 12 cyberattacks elevated temperatures in refrigerators across hundreds of French supermarkets, forcing establishments to discard entire inventories of perishable food goods. Similar incidents subsequently emerged in other European nations, with at least nine additional countries reporting disruptions to their freezer systems by November 2. 

In connection with the sabotage, Paris prosecutor Laure Beccuau opened an investigation into Shahid Kaveh, a shadowy cyber unit of the IRGC. Furthermore, the prosecutor's office has formally requested international arrest warrants for two officials associated with the Shahid Kaveh unit.

stories.title: North Waziristan matriculation exams postponed due to prevailing security situation
stories.summary:
The Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education in Bannu has postponed the Secondary School Certificate Second Annual Examination across North Waziristan. According to a notification issued by BISE Bannu on November 9, the decision was implemented following directions from the district's deputy commissioner regarding local security concerns.

Students and educational institutions have been advised to await further instructions, as a revised examination schedule will be released at a later date. However, exams at specific locations, including Cadet College Razmak and Bakakhel Tehsil along Miranshah Road, will proceed according to their original schedules. Last month, examinations in Bannu, Lakki Marwat, and North Waziristan were similarly delayed due to law and order challenges.

Simultaneously, local authorities imposed a curfew in Mir Ali for the duration of an ongoing security operation. Restrictions commence daily from Isha prayer in Mir Ali and Bobli, while the Bannu-Miranshah Road remains closed to traffic. Area representative Malik Rohullah Khan noted that the general officer commanding permitted residents to access markets in Miranshah and Datta Khel for essential supplies and use specific routes to travel outside the district.

Security challenges continue to impact Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, though recent statistics from the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies show a decline in regional violence. In October, the province recorded 40 terrorist attacks compared to 58 in September, with associated fatalities dropping significantly. Meanwhile, the erstwhile Fata region experienced a more modest decrease in attacks during the same period.

stories.title: Government approves board changes for HESCO, SEPCO, and NESPAK
stories.summary:
The government has authorized significant leadership changes across three state-owned enterprises, which includes reconstituting two power supply companies and appointing a new chairman for an engineering firm. The approvals were granted during a meeting of the Cabinet Committee on State-Owned Enterprises.

The committee session took place on Tuesday under the leadership of Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue, Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, according to a statement released by the Finance Division. The agenda items focused specifically on appointing a chairman and independent director for National Engineering Services Pakistan, alongside reconstituting the Board of Directors for the Hyderabad Electric Supply Company and adding an independent director to the Board of Sukkur Electric Power Company.

Following deliberations, the committee formally approved both restructuring proposals. During the session, the finance minister underscored the importance of placing competent government representatives with appropriate institutional understanding and experience into ex-officio director positions to effectively represent their respective divisions.

stories.title: Pakistan logistics challenges hinder small businesses aiming for global markets
stories.summary:
Pakistani businesses expanding overseas face complex logistical hurdles that extend well beyond securing an international customer. While large corporations possess dedicated teams and freight efficiencies, small and medium-sized enterprises and emerging e-commerce brands struggle with high shipping costs, strict customs regulations, and difficult banking procedures. These obstacles can quickly turn profitable export orders into expensive operations, particularly when handling international returns, which are processed as fresh imports under customs laws and incur additional duties.

To achieve sustained growth, exporters must integrate logistics directly into their operational infrastructure, managing scheduled pickups, bulk processing, and warehousing. Companies like SkyNet Pakistan are increasingly supporting local exporters—such as over 133 textile businesses participating in the Heimtextil trade fair—by handling time-sensitive exhibition shipments, cargo coordination, and documentation. SkyNet's leadership notes a shift toward e-commerce and technology partnerships, with freight volumes growing across Karachi and Lahore since 2023, and international markets like the UK, US, and Europe seeing substantial growth through 2025 and 2026.

Overcoming these trade barriers requires broader systemic improvements across Pakistan's economic ecosystem. Industry stakeholders emphasize that customs documentation must become more digital and standardized, while banking procedures for international receipts need simplification without sacrificing compliance. Furthermore, managing high freight costs and expanding product appeal beyond the South Asian diaspora are critical for smaller exporters.

Ultimately, Pakistan's broader export ambitions depend on more than simply manufacturing goods for foreign buyers. Small and medium-sized businesses must be equipped to deliver goods reliably and navigate commercial trade realities. Streamlining every stage of the export journey—from the first international sale to scalable, regular shipments—is essential for turning isolated opportunities into long-term economic growth.

stories.title: Mauricio Pochettino Emerges as Leading Candidate for Manchester United
stories.summary:
United States men’s national team coach Mauricio Pochettino has surfaced as the top candidate to take over as manager of Manchester United, according to recent media reports. The English club's leadership is reportedly weighing the dismissal of current manager Michael Carrick after the team slid to 18th place in the Premier League table. The squad's struggles were highlighted by a 4-4 draw against Aston Villa, leaving the club winless across three losses and five draws since August 30.

Manchester United is enduring its worst-ever start to a Premier League campaign, recording only a single victory and accumulating just eight points through their opening 10 matches. Pochettino, aged 54, brings extensive club management experience from Tottenham, Chelsea, and Paris Saint-Germain prior to assuming leadership of the USMNT in 2024. His contract with the U.S. squad was extended through 2030 following a run to the round of 16 at the World Cup.

Beyond Pochettino, club executives are reportedly evaluating alternative candidates for the managerial vacancy. These potential options include former Newcastle United manager Eddie Howe, former Ipswich Town coach Kieran McKenna, and former German national team coach Julian Nagelsmann. Nagelsmann stepped down from his post after Germany exited the World Cup in the round of 32 during July.

The team's upcoming fixture is scheduled against Liverpool on November 22, following the conclusion of the current international break. The club's hierarchy faces mounting pressure to reverse the team's historic slump as the season progresses through its foundational months.

stories.title: مریم نواز کا جہلم میں خطاب، غریبوں کے حقوق اور ترقی کا عزم
stories.summary:
وزیرِ اعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز نے جہلم میں ایک تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ پہلی بار صوبائی حکومت غریب اور محنت کش طبقے کے ساتھ کھڑی ہے اور اب طاقت اور پیسے کا غرور نہیں چلے گا۔ انہوں نے ایک واقعے کا ذکر کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ جب ایک دکاندار نے بچی پر تشدد کیا تو انہوں نے بچی کو تھانے بلا کر حکم دیا کہ اس مالدار شخص کو زور دار تھپڑ مارے۔

مریم نواز کا کہنا تھا کہ وہ لاہور کی طرح راجن پور اور منڈی بہاؤالدین میں بھی ترقیاتی کام جاری رکھے ہوئے ہیں اور بڑے شہروں تک ترقی محدود رکھنے کی روایت ختم کر دی ہے۔ انہوں نے طلبہ کی کامیابی پر ان کے والدین کی قربانیوں کو سراہا اور کہا کہ صوبے کے 25 چھوٹے شہروں میں دل کے علاج کے لیے اسپتال بنائے جا رہے ہیں جبکہ سبز بسیں بھی چلائی جا رہی ہیں۔

وزیرِ اعلیٰ پنجاب نے خواتین کے خلاف تشدد کے خاتمے کے عالمی دن کے موقع پر اپنے پیغام میں بتایا کہ حکومت نے تین سال میں کھربوں روپے کے منصوبے شروع کیے ہیں اور اگر کسی میں بھی خیانت کا ثبوت ہے تو وہ جواب دہ ہیں۔ انہوں نے خیبر پختونخوا اور دیگر صوبوں میں کرپشن پر بات کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ وہ اپنے کسی بھی وزیر کے خلاف ثبوت ملنے پر اسے نہیں بخشیں گی۔

انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ حالیہ انتخابات میں مسلم لیگ ن کو کامیابی ملی ہے اور آج ہی ڈسٹرکٹ ہیڈ کوارٹر اسپتال جہلم میں کیتھ لیب کا افتتاح کیا گیا ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ ان کے مخالفین صرف باتیں کرنا جانتے ہیں جبکہ عوام کو بہتر سفری سہولتیں فراہم کی جا رہی ہیں اور میرٹ پر آنے والے کو ترقی سے کوئی نہیں روک سکتا۔

stories.title: کے پی سی بلیوز نے کراچی پریس کلب نائٹ کرکٹ ٹورنامنٹ جیت لیا
stories.summary:
کراچی پریس کلب سپر سکسز نائٹ کرکٹ ٹورنامنٹ کا فائنل میچ کے پی سی بلیوز اور فوٹوگرافرز الیون کے درمیان کھیلا گیا۔ اس یکطرفہ مقابلے میں کے پی سی بلیوز نے فوٹوگرافرز الیون کو 5 وکٹوں سے شکست دے کر ٹورنامنٹ کا ٹائٹل اپنے نام کر لیا۔ فاتح ٹیم کی کامیابی میں فاسٹ بولرز زاہد غفار، شامیر خان، راؤ افنان اور ارشاد سنجرانی کی شاندار بولنگ کا اہم کردار رہا۔

ناک آؤٹ بنیادوں پر کھیلے گئے اس ٹورنامنٹ میں پرنٹ، الیکٹرانک اور ڈیجیٹل میڈیا سے تعلق رکھنے والی کل 32 ٹیموں نے حصہ لیا تھا۔ ٹورنامنٹ کے سیمی فائنل میچز میں کے پی سی بلیوز نے روزنامہ ڈان کو جبکہ فوٹوگرافرز الیون نے سماء نیوز کو شکست دے کر فائنل کے لیے کوالیفائی کیا تھا۔ بہترین کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے مسلسل تین نصف سنچریاں اسکور کرنے والے کے پی سی بلیوز کے کپتان ثاقب صغیر کو ٹورنامنٹ کا بہترین کھلاڑی قرار دیا گیا۔

اختتامی تقریب کے دوران مہمانِ گرامی نیا ناظم آباد جمخانہ کے صدر محمد طلحہ، ہاکی فیڈریشن کے سابق سیکریٹری حیدر حسین، کراچی سٹی کرکٹ ایسوسی ایشن کے سابق سیکریٹری اعجاز فاروقی اور کراچی پریس کلب کے سیکریٹری اسلم خان نے کھلاڑیوں میں انعامات تقسیم کیے۔ اس موقع پر گورنگ باڈی کے ارکان اور سینئر اسپورٹس صحافی بھی تقریب میں موجود تھے۔

ٹورنامنٹ کی فاتح ٹیم کے پی سی بلیوز کو ونر ٹرافی کے ساتھ 50 ہزار روپے نقد انعام دیا گیا جبکہ رنر اپ رہنے والی فوٹوگرافرز الیون کی ٹیم کو ٹرافی اور 25 ہزار روپے کا انعام ملا۔ شائقین کی ایک بڑی تعداد نے اپنے اہل خانہ کے ہمراہ اس نائٹ کرکٹ ٹورنامنٹ کے تمام میچوں سے بھرپور لطف اٹھایا۔

stories.title: راولپنڈی اینکر قتل کیس: شوہر احسن کا پولی گراف ٹیسٹ کرانے کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی کی خاتون ٹی وی اینکر ربیعہ احسن کے قتل کے معاملے میں اہم پیشرفت سامنے آئی ہے جہاں گرفتار شوہر احسن کا پولی گراف ٹیسٹ کرانے کا فیصلہ کیا گیا ہے۔ تفتیشی ذرائع کے مطابق پولیس کی جانب سے ملزم کا یہ ٹیسٹ کل لاہور سے کروایا جائے گا تاکہ واقعے کے اصل حقائق سامنے آ سکیں۔

پولیس کو توقع ہے کہ اس پولی گراف ٹیسٹ کی حتمی رپورٹ ہفتے کے روز تک موصول ہو جائے گی۔ یاد رہے کہ یہ افسوسناک واقعہ راولپنڈی کے علاقے اڈیالہ روڈ پر واقع گلشن آباد میں پیش آیا تھا جہاں اینکر ربیعہ احسن کو ان کے گھر میں مبینہ طور پر قتل کیا گیا تھا۔

واقعے کے بعد پولیس نے جائے وقوعہ سے اسلحہ برآمد کر کے مقتولہ کے بھائی کی مدعیت میں شوہر احسن کے خلاف مقدمہ درج کیا تھا اور انہیں حراست میں لے لیا تھا۔ گرفتاری کے بعد ابتدائی بیان میں ملزم احسن نے مؤقف اختیار کیا تھا کہ گولی اتفاقیہ چلی تھی جو ربیعہ کو جا لگی۔

اس مقدمے کی تفتیش کے دوران اب سائنسی بنیادوں پر تحقیقات کو آگے بڑھایا جا رہا ہے تاکہ یہ واضح ہو سکے کہ آیا فائرنگ واقعی اتفاقیہ تھی یا یہ ایک باقاعدہ جرم تھا۔ اس دوران مقتولہ ربیعہ احسن کی نمازِ جنازہ بھی ادا کر دی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: شمالی وزیرستان میں سیکیورٹی فورسز کا آپریشن، دھماکا خیز مواد اور میزائل برآمد
stories.summary:
شمالی وزیرستان کے مختلف علاقوں میں سیکیورٹی فورسز کی جانب سے سرچ اور کلیئرنس آپریشنز کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔ کارروائی کے دوران فورسز نے دہشت گردوں کے خلاف مؤثر اقدامات کرتے ہوئے بھاری مقدار میں اسلحہ اور دھماکا خیز مواد برآمد کیا ہے۔

سیکیورٹی ذرائع کے مطابق آپریشن کے دوران متعدد علاقوں میں گھروں اور کمپاؤنڈز کی مکمل تلاشی لی گئی۔ اس دوران گاؤں اپی سے حیدر خیل تک 17، مسکی میں 28 اور حسو خیل سمیت دیگر مقامات پر درجنوں کمپاؤنڈز کو کلیئر کیا گیا تاکہ وہاں چھپے ہوئے مشکوک عناصر کا خاتمہ کیا جا سکے۔

موساکی کے علاقے میں کی گئی کارروائی کے دوران 700 کلو گرام دیسی ساختہ دھماکا خیز مواد برآمد کیا گیا۔ اس کے علاوہ حسو خیل سے ایک الفاروق میزائل، 200 کلو گرام یوریا کھاد اور دیگر متعلقہ آلات بھی فورسز کے ہاتھ لگے۔

سیکیورٹی ذرائع کا کہنا ہے کہ یہ آپریشن علاقے میں دہشت گردوں کی ممکنہ موجودگی کے مکمل خاتمے اور ان کے تمام زیرِ استعمال ٹھکانوں کو صاف کرنے تک جاری رہے گا، تاکہ مقامی آبادی کے جان و مال کا تحفظ یقینی بنایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: بلوچستان کے ضلع کیچ میں انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشن، دو دہشت گرد ہلاک
stories.summary:
بلوچستان کے ضلع کیچ کے علاقے دشت اور بال نگور میں سیکیورٹی فورسز نے خفیہ اطلاعات کی بنیاد پر ایک کامیاب انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشن کیا۔ اس کارروائی کے دوران سیکیورٹی فورسز اور دہشت گردوں کے درمیان فائرنگ کا شدید تبادلہ ہوا۔

پاک فوج کے شعبۂ تعلقاتِ عامہ (آئی ایس پی آر) کے جاری کردہ بیان کے مطابق اس شدید فائرنگ کے تبادلے کے نتیجے میں فتنۃ الخوارج کے دو دہشت گرد ہلاک ہو گئے۔ آپریشن کے دوران ان عناصر کے مساجد میں بنائے گئے دو خفیہ ٹھکانوں کو بھی مکمل طور پر کلیئر کر دیا گیا۔

کارروائی کے بعد ہلاک ہونے والے دہشت گردوں کے قبضے سے جدید اسلحہ، مواصلاتی یا کمیونیکیشن کا سامان اور نقدی برآمد کی گئی۔ آئی ایس پی آر کا کہنا ہے کہ برآمد شدہ رقم میں وہ نقدی بھی شامل ہے جو عام بلوچ شہریوں سے زبردستی لوٹی گئی تھی۔

اس کامیاب آپریشن کے بعد سیکیورٹی فورسز کی جانب سے علاقے میں کسی بھی مزید خطرے کے پیشِ نظر سرچ اور کلیئرنس آپریشن کا سلسلہ تاحال جاری ہے تاکہ علاقے کو مکمل طور پر محفوظ بنایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Rain Washes Out Third One-Day International Between New Zealand and India
stories.summary:
Heavy rain in Hamilton forced the abandonment of the third one-day international match between the New Zealand and India cricket teams on Tuesday. Officials called off the fixture without a single ball being bowled. Despite the cancellation, the touring Indian squad maintains a 2-0 advantage in the ongoing five-match series.

The two sides will travel to Mount Maunganui for the remaining fourth and fifth matches of the series, which are scheduled to be played on Friday and Sunday. Following the conclusion of the one-day internationals, the itinerary continues with a two-match Test series. The first Test is set to begin in Wellington next week, with the second Test taking place in Christchurch at the end of the month.

This current tour forms a significant part of the historical sporting celebrations between the two nations, as New Zealand and India officially mark one hundred years of athletic rivalry. The upcoming matches in Mount Maunganui will determine the final outcome of the limited-overs series before both squads shift their focus to the longer Test format.

stories.title: US President Trump Nominates Natalie Baker as Ambassador to Pakistan
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump has officially nominated Natalie Baker to serve as the next US ambassador to Pakistan. Baker is currently functioning as the charge d’affaires at the American embassy located in Islamabad, a post she assumed in January 2025 following the departure of former ambassador Donald Armin Blome. Prior to taking on her current responsibilities, Baker arrived in Islamabad as the deputy chief of mission in August 2024.

The official White House announcement confirms that the nomination has been duly submitted to the US Senate. The Senate's foreign relations committee is tasked with reviewing the selection first. Should the committee grant its approval, the nomination will then move forward to a full vote before the entire Senate for final confirmation.

Baker brings extensive diplomatic experience to the prospective ambassadorial position. Her previous assignments include working as the deputy chief of mission at the US embassy in Doha from August 2021 until July 2024. Additionally, she has served as the deputy chief of mission and charge d’affaires for the US Mission to Libya, deputy director of the Iran Regional Presence Office stationed at the US consulate in Dubai, and economic counsellor at the US embassy in Kuwait.

Early in her career, she also directed the Office of North African Affairs within the Near Eastern Affairs Bureau of the US State Department. Notably, between 2009 and 2011, she worked as a political and economic counsellor in Libya during a period when bilateral ties were normalizing after a hiatus of nearly thirty years, remaining there until the outbreak of the Libyan Revolution forced the embassy's evacuation in February 2011.

stories.title: Saud Shakeel Nears Century as Pakistan Reaches 390-6 Against Sri Lanka
stories.summary:
Batting on the second day of the opening Test match in Rawalpindi, Pakistan advanced their total to 390-6 by the lunch break. Left-handed batter Saud Shakeel moved closer to reaching a century after starting the day with 57 runs. During the extended two-and-a-half-hour morning session, the 31-year-old accumulated an additional 34 runs to stand at 91 not out from 192 deliveries, remaining just nine runs shy of securing his fifth Test hundred. 

Pakistan commenced the day's play from their overnight score of 281-5. Throughout the morning session, the batting side experienced only a single dismissal when Ghazi Ghori departed for 48 runs. Alongside Ghori, Shakeel had previously established a vital 96-run partnership for the sixth wicket, while Arafat Minhas remained undefeated on 27 runs when the players broke for lunch. Shakeel's innings so far featured nine hits to the boundary.

Opposing bowlers from Sri Lanka entered the day seeking early breakthroughs, yet they encountered difficulties on a surface that appeared hard and green. Even after taking the second new delivery past the 80-over mark, the bowling unit found it hard to dismantle the remaining partnership. Dilshan Madushanka eventually claimed the morning's lone wicket by inducing an edge from Ghori toward the gully position, where Pasindu Sooriyabandara secured a low catch.

Among the visiting bowlers, pace contributors Asitha Fernando, who claimed 2-87, and Dilshan Madushanka, registering figures of 2-97, emerged as the most effective performers for the Sri Lankan attack. Following the conclusion of this opening fixture in Rawalpindi, the two-match Test series will shift to Lahore for the second and final encounter starting on November 17.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Orders Urgent High-Level Inquiry Into Tarbela Dam Incident
stories.summary:
The Ministry of Water Resources and the Prime Minister's Office have intervened following a structural accident at the Tarbela Extension Project construction site. Government officials expressed deep concern and displeasure over the occurrence, categorizing such events at the national infrastructure project as completely unacceptable.

Authorities have mandated a comprehensive high-level investigation to determine accountability and finalize findings within a single week. To guarantee an objective assessment, the federal administration instructed that external specialists from outside the Water and Power Development Authority join the newly formed inquiry committee.

Insiders indicate that the unfortunate collapse will likely generate adverse impacts on both electrical generation and water reserves. Officials underscored the gravity of the situation by questioning how oversight failures could transpire within an undertaking carrying substantial national significance and economic value.

Prior concerns regarding the Tarbela Extension Project had already been raised before a weak rock section collapsed during excavation work on Monday, allowing water to flood a tunnel and powerhouse at the T-5 site. Although the Water and Power Development Authority verified that all personnel were successfully evacuated without harm, the federal administration has additionally ordered heightened security measures across all ongoing water development initiatives.

stories.title: Trump Surprises White House Press Room with UFC Chief Dana White
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump sparked a sudden scramble in the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room at the White House by making an abrupt appearance alongside Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO Dana White. The impromptu event caused such swift bedlam that White House aides did not even have adequate time to place the customary presidential seal onto the podium.

The unusual briefing followed recent political events, including heavy Republican losses during the midterm elections. Shortly after, Trump had joked on Saturday that he offered White the position of White House press secretary, later clarifying on Sunday that he was only teasing. Despite the joke, White traveled to Washington to visit the president, prompting an urgent loudspeaker announcement that caused a stampede of journalists, TV technicians, and camera crews rushing to set up equipment.

During the briefing, Trump bantered with White about upcoming UFC events, including a fight at Madison Square Garden featuring top women fighters, and humorously asked how he would fare against them. White, who previously organized UFC bouts on White House grounds in June, firmly stated that he has zero political aspirations and no desire to engage with reporters on a daily basis.

Although Trump was a frequent presence in the briefing room during his first term, he rarely takes questions there halfway through his second term, having previously considered moving the press corps to another location. On Monday, after addressing various national and international topics such as Iran, Ukraine, Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Trump playfully renewed his offer to White, asking if he wanted the press secretary job or preferred his UFC role, to which White declined, reiterating that he wants nothing to do with politics.

stories.title: Mitchell Starc denies ball-tampering awareness as Cricket Australia rejects probe
stories.summary:
Australian fast bowler Mitchell Starc stated on Tuesday in Sydney that he had no prior knowledge of the 2018 ball-tampering plot in South Africa. Starc is the first bowler to respond to claims made by Usman Khawaja in his autobiography and on social media, where Khawaja asserted that the entire team knew about the plan to manipulate the ball. Starc reiterated the bowlers' 2021 stance that they were unaware of foreign substances being brought onto the field.

The 2018 scandal, known as Sandpapergate, emerged during the Cape Town Test and led to bans and penalties for then-captain Steve Smith, David Warner, and Cameron Bancroft. Khawaja claimed the tampering actually began during the second Test in Gqeberha, a timeline Starc said he was previously unaware of. Warner recently backed Khawaja's account as accurate and criticized the original Cricket Australia investigation as rushed and botched, prompting calls from pundits like Michael Clarke to reopen the probe.

Despite the renewed controversy, Cricket Australia boss Todd Greenberg stated on Tuesday that there is no compelling reason to reinvestigate, noting that player versions of events differ and that the governing body remains comfortable with the original outcome. Former CEO James Sutherland and Cameron Bancroft declined to comment on the matter.

Current captain Pat Cummins previously mentioned he discussed the issue with Khawaja before the book's release and felt it had already been dealt with. Meanwhile, Khawaja defended himself against critics accusing him of timing his revelations to boost sales for his book "Sabr," stating that he has no commercial motives and does not need the money.

stories.title: IMF urges Pakistan to swiftly privatize public power distribution companies
stories.summary:
The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has strongly advised the government of Pakistan to complete the privatization of public-funded power distribution companies without delay. Official sources reported that the international lender cautioned authorities against continuing to operate these state-owned utilities under public management, emphasizing that timely privatization is crucial to removing their financial losses from the public sector budget.

The IMF pointed out that energy sector losses constitute a major portion of the overall deficits affecting state-owned corporations. According to the lender, the national budget deficit will remain out of control and further economic damage will occur unless these distribution companies are successfully transferred to the private sector.

This push comes as Pakistan pursues a broader overhaul of its electricity distribution network. The government currently targets the privatization of three specific entities—the Faisalabad Electric Supply Company, the Gujranwala Electric Power Company, and the Islamabad Electric Supply Company—during the first quarter of 2027, with additional transactions planned later that year.

stories.title: جمائما گولڈ سمتھ کا سابق بوائے فرینڈ رسل برینڈ پر تشدد کا الزام
stories.summary:
برطانوی کامیڈین اور اداکار رسل برینڈ کو ایک خاتون کے ریپ اور تین دیگر خواتین کے جنسی حملوں کے مقدمے میں مجرم قرار دیے جانے کے بعد ساڑھے دس سال قید کی سزا سنا دی گئی ہے۔ عدالت نے فیصلہ سناتے ہوئے کہا کہ مجرم نے خواتین کے انکار کے حق کو نظر انداز کیا۔ اس عدالتی فیصلے کے بعد جمائما گولڈ سمتھ نے انکشاف کیا کہ سال 2014 کے دوران ان کے تعلقات کے وقت رسل برینڈ نے ان پر بھی تشدد اور بدسلوکی کی تھی۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ ایک پُر تشدد واقعے کے دوران انہیں اپنے گھر سے برینڈ کو نکلوانے کی خاطر مجبوباً پولیس بلانا پڑی تھی۔

جمائما گولڈ سمتھ نے اس مبینہ واقعے کے وقت قانونی کارروائی نہ کرنے کا فیصلہ اس وجہ سے کیا تھا کیونکہ وہ اپنے نوعمر بچوں پر میڈیا کی توجہ کے منفی اثرات سے سخت فکرمند تھیں۔ تاہم انہوں نے برینڈ کے خلاف تحقیقات کرنے والے صحافیوں کی معاونت کی اور گواہی دینے کے لیے بھی تیار تھیں۔ جمائما کا یہ بھی کہنا ہے کہ مقدمے کے بعد انہیں آن لائن شدید نفرت کا سامنا کرنا پڑا ہے لیکن وہ ان تمام بہادر خواتین کی جرات کی معترف ہیں جنہوں نے عدالت میں حقائق بیان کیے۔

اس مقدمے میں چار ہفتوں تک سماعت جاری رہی جس میں متاثرہ خواتین نے اپنے اوپر گزرنے والے ذہنی صدمات اور پریشانیوں کے بارے میں عدالت کو بتایا۔ سزا پانے کے بعد رسل برینڈ کو لندن کی ایک جیل منتقل کر دیا گیا جہاں وہ قواعد کے مطابق اپنی سزا کا مقررہ حصہ گزاریں گے۔ اس پورے معاملے نے ایک بار پھر نامور شخصیات کے ہاتھوں ہونے والے تشدد اور جنسی جرائم کے خلاف آواز اٹھانے کی اہمیت کو اجاگر کیا ہے۔

stories.title: Mitchell Starc maintains stance on 2018 Sandpapergate following Khawaja book
stories.summary:
Australian fast bowler Mitchell Starc confirmed on Tuesday in Sydney that his position on the 2018 ball-tampering scandal remains unchanged following new assertions by former teammate Usman Khawaja in his book, "Sabr." Khawaja alleged that awareness of the sandpaper plot during the tour of South Africa extended beyond the three players who received suspensions—Steve Smith, David Warner, and Cameron Bancroft.

Speaking at a promotional event for the upcoming cricket season, Starc expressed disappointment over the renewed controversy surrounding the eight-year-old incident. He stated that he had not closely followed the recent developments but stood firmly by the account he and his teammates provided during the 2021 investigation.

Addressing whether the bowling group knew about the plan to use sandpaper, Starc pointed back to the joint statement issued in 2021 by himself, Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood, and Nathan Lyon. The four bowlers collectively maintained at the time that they were entirely unaware of sandpaper being brought onto the field.

stories.title: Thai baht holds steady against the US dollar in Tuesday trading
stories.summary:
The Thai baht experienced minimal movement against the US dollar during Tuesday trading sessions in Bangkok. Market data from LSEG showed that the currency remained largely steady after closing its previous session at 33.4025 per dollar.

At 0133 GMT on Tuesday, the baht traded down by just 0.05% at 33.42 against the dollar. Throughout the session, it moved within a narrow range between 33.385 and 33.433 per dollar.

stories.title: Asian Development Bank Reports Massive Infrastructure Funding Shortfall in Southeast Asia
stories.summary:
According to a newly published report by the Asian Development Bank, Southeast Asian economies require up to $7.1 trillion in infrastructure investments by the year 2040. This figure represents a significant upward revision from the bank's previous assessment made nearly ten years ago, which projected $3.15 trillion for the 2016 through 2030 timeframe. Consequently, the region is now confronting a massive financial shortfall amounting to nearly $4 trillion as it looks toward the next fifteen years.

The report emphasizes that current expenditures by Association of Southeast Asian Nations governments are only sufficient to cover forty-five percent of these projected infrastructure demands. In terms of sectoral priorities, half of all required investments are directed toward electricity, while another third must be dedicated to enhancing transportation networks, which include roadways, rail systems, and airports. Overall, the Manila-based institution urges regional authorities to place primary focus on projects that enhance health, power, and transit.

Closing this substantial deficit will require a strategic shift in how money is deployed, since private financial capital remains restricted across the area. The multilateral lender explains that the shortfall can only be successfully diminished if public funds are utilized in a manner that actively attracts private financing under stable and predictable conditions. Stronger regional collaboration among member states is also regarded as an essential component for achieving these long-term developmental goals.

Addressing these expansive regional infrastructure targets is considered vital for sustaining economic growth and improving basic public services throughout the block. By realigning both public and private financial resources, nations can hope to bridge the massive gap identified in the updated assessment. The comprehensive findings were officially released by the development bank on Tuesday.

stories.title: Rain Forces Abandonment of Third One-Day International Between India and New Zealand
stories.summary:
The third one-day international cricket fixture between New Zealand and India was officially called off on Tuesday. Persistent rain in Hamilton prevented any play from taking place, resulting in the match being abandoned without a single ball being bowled. Despite the washout, the touring Indian squad maintains a 2-0 advantage in the ongoing five-match bilateral series.

Following this weather disruption, both teams will travel to Mount Maunganui to contest the fourth and fifth games of the series on Friday and Sunday respectively. Once the limited-overs fixtures conclude, the two nations are scheduled to transition into a two-Test series. The red-ball matches will begin in Wellington next week before concluding with the final Test in Christchurch at the end of the month.

This current tour forms part of a broader commemoration celebrating a century of sporting rivalry between New Zealand and India. The historical milestone highlights decades of competitive athletic engagement between the two cricketing nations. As the teams prepare for the remaining limited-overs encounters, they do so under the backdrop of this significant bilateral milestone.

Separately, the broader sports world noted that former Pakistan cricket captain Shahid Afridi recently spent a three-day vacation in Dubai with his youngest daughter, Arwa. Sharing moments from the trip on social media, the former cricketer highlighted the special father-daughter getaway. However, the immediate focus for the international cricketing community remains on the resumption of the India and New Zealand series in Mount Maunganui.

stories.title: سپریم کورٹ نے عمر قید کاٹنے والے ملزم نجف خان کو بری کر دیا۔
stories.summary:
سپریم کورٹ نے ایک قتل کے مقدمے میں عمر قید کی سزا پوری کرنے والے ملزم نجف خان کی بریت کی درخواست منظور کرتے ہوئے اسے تمام الزامات سے بری کر دیا۔ عدالتِ عظمیٰ میں اس کیس کی سماعت جسٹس ہاشم کاکڑ کی سربراہی میں قائم تین رکنی بینچ نے کی۔

دورانِ سماعت درخواست گزار کے وکیل نے عدالت کو بتایا کہ ان کے مؤکل اپنی عمر قید کی سزا مکمل کر کے پہلے ہی رہا ہو چکے ہیں، تاہم وہ اس مقدمے سے میرٹ پر مکمل بریت چاہتے ہیں۔ وکیل نے مؤقف اختیار کیا کہ مقتول غلام محمد کے قتل کے سلسلے میں دو افراد کے خلاف ایف آئی آر درج کی گئی تھی۔

وکیل نے عدالت کے سامنے پیش کی گئی فارنزک لیبارٹری کی رپورٹ کا حوالہ دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ سائنسی جانچ سے یہ ثابت ہوا کہ قتل ان کے مؤکل کے پستول سے چلنے والی گولی سے نہیں ہوا تھا۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ جس شخص کی فائرنگ سے اصل میں قتل ہوا تھا، وہ پہلے ہی اس کیس سے بری ہو چکا ہے۔

وکیل نے مزید نشاندہی کی کہ ڈاکٹر کی رپورٹ میں صرف ایک پستول سے فائرنگ کا ذکر موجود ہے جبکہ ابتدائی ایف آئی آر میں دو رائفلز کا تذکرہ کیا گیا تھا۔ تمام فریقین کے دلائل سننے کے بعد سپریم کورٹ نے نجف خان کی اپیل منظور کرتے ہوئے انہیں قتل کے الزام سے بری کرنے کا حکم دے دیا۔

stories.title: امریکی صدر نے نیٹلی بیکر کو پاکستان میں نیا سفیر نامزد کر دیا
stories.summary:
امریکی حکومت کی جانب سے پاکستان کے لیے ایک اہم سفارتی تقرری عمل میں لائی گئی ہے جہاں نیٹلی بیکر کو ملک میں امریکا کی نئی سفیر نامزد کیا گیا ہے۔ وائٹ ہاؤس کے مطابق اس نامزدگی کی منظوری کے لیے دستاویزات امریکی سینیٹ کو بھجوا دی گئی ہیں۔ سفارتی ذرائع کا کہنا ہے کہ گزشتہ اسی برسوں کے دوران پاکستان اور امریکا کے باہمی تعلقات میں مزید استحکام آیا ہے۔

نیٹلی بیکر اس وقت پاکستان میں امریکی سفارت خانے میں ناظم الامور کے طور پر ذمہ داریاں نبھا رہی ہیں۔ اس سے قبل وہ قطر کے دارالحکومت دوحہ میں امریکی سفارت خانے میں ڈپٹی چیف آف مشن بھی تعینات رہ چکی ہیں۔ ان کی تعلیمی پس منظر میں پرنسٹن یونیورسٹی سے بیچلرز، ہارورڈ یونیورسٹی کے کینیڈی اسکول آف گورنمنٹ سے پبلک پالیسی میں ماسٹرز اور نیشنل ڈیفنس یونیورسٹی کے نیشنل وار کالج سے گریجویشن شامل ہے۔

علاوه ازیں، امریکی صدر کی جانب سے دنیا کے دیگر ممالک کے لیے بھی نئے سفیروں کی نامزدیاں کی گئی ہیں جن میں جیفری کولائر کو متحدہ عرب امارات، سنتھیا کیرشٹ کو سینیگال جبکہ ایان میک کیری کو مالی میں سفیر نامزد کرنا شامل ہے۔ اس سفارتی عمل کا مقصد مختلف ممالک کے ساتھ تعلقات کو مزید مؤثر بنانا اور باہمی تعاون کو فروغ دینا ہے۔

stories.title: فیصل آباد میں نجی اسکول کی چھت گرنے سے پندرہ طالب علم زخمی
stories.summary:
فیصل آباد کے علاقے چک 132 آر بی میں واقع ایک نجی اسکول میں ناخوشگوار واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں ایک کمرے کی چھت کا حصہ اچانک نیچے آ گرا۔ چھت گرنے کے اس حادثے کے نتیجے میں ملبے تلے دب جانے کی وجہ سے پندرہ طالب علم زخمی ہو گئے۔

حادثے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی ریسکیو ادارے کے اہلکار فوری طور پر جائے وقوعہ پر پہنچ گئے اور امدادی کارروائیاں شروع کیں۔ ریسکیو حکام کے مطابق تمام زخمی طالب علموں کو فوری طور پر ملبے سے نکال کر تحصیل ہیڈکوارٹر اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا جہاں انہیں طبی امداد فراہم کی جا رہی ہے۔

اسکول کی عمارت کے خستہ حال یا کمزور حصے کے بیٹھ جانے کے اس واقعے نے بچوں کے والدین اور مقامی شہریوں میں شدید تشویش دوچار کر دیا ہے۔ انتظامیہ اور متعلقہ حکام کی جانب سے اس حادثے کی وجوہات کا جائزہ لینے اور اسکولوں کی عمارتوں کے حفاظتی معیارات کی جانچ پڑتال کیے جانے کی ضرورت پر زور دیا جا رہا ہے۔

اس حادثے کے بعد علاقے میں کہرام مچ گیا اور والدین بڑی تعداد میں اسپتال اور اسکول پہنچے۔ ضلعی انتظامیہ اور ریسکیو ذرائع نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ تمام زخمی بچوں کو بروقت اسپتال پہنچا دیے جانے کے باعث مزید بڑے جانی نقصان سے بچاؤ ہو گیا۔

stories.title: Trump Cites Positive Momentum on Iran After Meeting Qatar Prime Minister
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated on Monday that there is positive momentum toward concluding the conflict with Iran, describing the country as militarily finished while keeping the possibility of future strikes open. Trump made these remarks following a White House meeting with Qatar's Prime Minister, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, who acts as a key mediator in the war. The discussions marked Trump's first meeting with a foreign leader following substantial losses by his party in the midterm elections, a defeat he acknowledged was partly tied to the unpopular war and resulting domestic economic pressures.

During a White House press briefing, Trump reiterated that while further military actions are unlikely because Gulf allies favor maintaining the status quo, the US military remains ready to intervene if necessary. Meanwhile, Iranian officials responded with defiance. Top security chief Mohsen Rezai dismissed the administration's stance on X, while Tehran's negotiator Bagher Ghalibaf warned that Washington risks leading allies toward a dark age due to an Israeli-first mindset. On-the-ground strikes continue in Iran, with local authorities reporting an overnight attack on the island of Qeshm in the Strait of Hormuz.

The conflict has significantly impacted US-Iran relations, drawing reactions from international figures and worsening regional stability. The meeting in Washington highlights ongoing diplomatic mediation efforts by Gulf leaders like Qatar's prime minister, even as underlying military and political tensions persist between Washington and Tehran.

stories.title: عالمی اور مقامی سطح پر سونے کے داموں میں کمی
stories.summary:
عالمی اور مقامی صرافہ مارکیٹوں میں سونے کی قیمتوں میں کمی ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے جبکہ چاندی کے نرخ بدستور مستحکم رہے ہیں۔ بین الاقوامی بلین مارکیٹ میں فی اونس سونے کی قیمت میں 15 ڈالر کی کمی واقع ہوئی، جس کے بعد یہ گھٹ کر 4 ہزار 083 ڈالر کی سطح پر آ گئی۔

بین الاقوامی مارکیٹ کے اثرات مقامی سطح پر بھی دیکھے گئے جہاں فی تولہ سونے کی قیمت 1 ہزار 500 روپے کی کمی سے 4 لاکھ 30 ہزار 836 روپے ہو گئی۔ اسی طرح فی 10 گرام سونے کی قیمت 1 ہزار 286 روپے گھٹ کر 3 لاکھ 69 ہزار 372 روپے کی سطح پر پہنچ گئی۔

دوسری جانب چاندی کے نرخوں میں کسی قسم کی تبدیلی رونما نہیں ہوئی۔ مقامی بازار میں فی تولہ چاندی 5 ہزار 723 روپے اور فی 10 گرام چاندی 4 ہزار 906 روپے پر برقرار رہی۔ اس مندی سے سونے کے خریداروں کو کچھ ریلیف ملا ہے۔

stories.title: Japan Shares Jump Nearly Three Percent as AI-Related Stocks Rebound
stories.summary:
Japan's Nikkei share average advanced 2.88 percent to reach 60,471.05 by 0158 GMT on Tuesday, recovering significantly from a major tech-led selloff that occurred late last week. The broader Topix index also increased by 2.27 percent to 3,904.67. The recent market downturn had been driven by concerns that the US Congress might slow artificial intelligence investments following the Democratic Party's victory in the midterm elections.

Despite a 4.2 percent overnight drop in Nvidia shares linked to controversy surrounding CEO Jensen Huang, broader Japanese technology and chip stocks performed strongly. Technology investor SoftBank Group surged 14.38 percent, while Advantest and Tokyo Electron climbed 4.93 percent and 5.66 percent, respectively. According to analysts, investors viewed the issues affecting Nvidia as isolated rather than indicative of problems across the entire technology sector. Additionally, outstanding margin-buying positions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange dropped as investors sold shares to avoid margin calls.

Other notable market movements included JX Advanced Metals rising 2.2 percent after lifting its net profit forecast by 14 percent for the year ending next March. Conversely, Toyota Motor fell 1.63 percent and Kikkoman declined 13 percent, serving as significant drags on the major indices.

stories.title: Ukraine, Russia, and United States Set to Begin Abu Dhabi Peace Talks
stories.summary:
Negotiators representing Ukraine, Russia, and the United States are gathering in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday to hold talks aimed at resolving the conflict in Europe, marking the first such meeting in over nine months. The negotiations are organized by US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, son-in-law of US President Donald Trump, following previous Geneva talks in February. The diplomatic push comes as European nations grow increasingly alarmed that Washington might force a disadvantageous settlement on Kyiv, particularly after Trump recently suggested that Ukraine's borders may change.

The diplomatic engagement follows intense fighting, highlighted by a Russian strike that killed 55 people in a frontline village as residents queued for humanitarian aid, alongside a barrage of 162 drones and a ballistic missile overnight. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky argued that Moscow is intensifying attacks to pressure Kyiv's position at the negotiating table. Russia maintains demands that Ukraine surrender control over remaining parts of the Donetsk region, a condition that Kyiv, which has resisted the invasion for nearly five years, firmly rejects.

European capitals have expressed deep concern over the discussions and potential back-door agreements regarding a new European security architecture. Representatives from Britain, France, Germany, Italy, along with NATO and EU officials, are scheduled to hold separate consultations with Ukrainian representatives in Abu Dhabi. Despite the diplomatic activity, expectations for an immediate breakthrough remain low among Ukrainian officials.

stories.title: Australian Dollar Holds Gains Amid Oil Plunge and Weak Economic Surveys
stories.summary:
The Australian and New Zealand dollars maintained their gains on Tuesday, supported by a sharp decline in oil prices that fueled a broader rally in risk assets. The Australian dollar eased slightly by 0.1 percent to $0.6916 after a strong overnight rally, helping offset a 2.5 percent decline from the previous week. Meanwhile, the New Zealand dollar held steady at $0.5633, benefiting from election results that confirmed Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's three-party coalition will govern with a slim two-seat majority, signaling policy stability and fiscal restraint.

In contrast, new economic surveys in Australia revealed a grim outlook following five interest rate hikes this year. Consumer sentiment dropped to a four-year low in November, while business conditions remained in negative territory for the first time in six years. Economists noted that these indicators signal that the Reserve Bank of Australia's rate hikes, which pushed interest rates to an 18-year high of 4.85 percent, are actively slowing consumption and business pricing power even as core inflation remains above target at 3.6 percent.

Financial markets indicate an 82 percent probability that Australian interest rates have peaked, with a quarter-point rate cut fully anticipated by the end of 2027. Reflecting these expectations, Australia's 10-year government bond yields fell by 3 basis points to 4.993 percent, marking their lowest level since late August.

stories.title: Federal Health Minister Releases Vaccine Procurement Inquiry Report
stories.summary:
Federal Health Minister Mustafa Kamal announced during a news conference in Islamabad that the Prime Minister has ordered the publication of the vaccine procurement inquiry committee's report on the official website of the Ministry of National Health Services.

During his address, Kamal stated that the government did not spend any money throughout the procedure. He explained that 183.055 million rupees were collected for the vaccines, with the total sum deposited into NADRA's account, and noted that the financial loss was absorbed by the supplier rather than the state. He also dismissed allegations of a 10 billion rupee vaccine purchase, clarifying that the committee's report contains no reference to such a figure.

Providing background on the issue, the minister mentioned that the Border Health Services formed its procurement committee on June 10. He stated that the body completely breached procurement regulations by improperly combining public-private partnership guidelines with standard procurement rules, while also failing to inform the Ministry of Health about the actions.

The investigation was launched by a high-powered committee appointed by the Prime Minister following media coverage of the procedures, and a company also pursued court action related to the situation.

stories.title: Aryna Sabalenka and Mirra Andreeva Secure Opening Wins at WTA Finals
stories.summary:
Aryna Sabalenka secured a straight-sets victory against Karolina Muchova with a 7-6 (7/2), 7-5 scoreline lasting under two hours in her opening match at the season-ending WTA Finals in Indian Wells on Monday.

The second-seeded competitor from Belarus, seeking her maiden WTA Finals title following losses in the 2022 and 2025 finals, overcame a deficit in the first set before winning the tie-break. Despite surrendering a break while serving for the match at 5-4 in the second set, she immediately broke back and sealed the contest when Muchova hit a backhand into the net.

In Monday's other group match, 19-year-old French Open champion Mirra Andreeva defeated Ukraine's Elina Svitolina 6-4, 6-0 despite struggling with initial nervousness. The third-seeded tournament debutant broke serve to establish a 4-2 lead in the opening set before dominating the second set with three service breaks.

Andreeva and Sabalenka are scheduled to meet in their second round-robin fixture on Wednesday. This year's tournament was originally planned for Saudi Arabia but was relocated to Indian Wells in July following US military strikes on Iran in February and the subsequent regional conflict.

stories.title: بھارتی لڑکی نے نیند کا انوکھا مقابلہ جیت لیا
stories.summary:
بھارت میں منعقدہ ایک منفرد اور دلچسپ مقابلے میں مسلسل دو ماہ تک سونے کا معمول برقرار رکھنے والی لڑکی جینیا چیٹرجی نے پہلی پوزیشن حاصل کر لی۔ اس مقابلے میں کامیابی پر انہیں نقد انعام کے ساتھ ساتھ ایک سیاحتی دورے کا ٹکٹ بھی دیا گیا۔

مقابلے کا اہتمام گھریلو استعمال کی اشیا بنانے والی ایک کمپنی کی جانب سے کیا گیا تھا، جس میں ملک بھر سے دو لاکھ سے زائد افراد نے درخواستیں دیں۔ کڑے مراحل اور انٹرویوز کے بعد صرف 10 امیدواروں کو فائنل کے لیے چنا گیا۔ شرکاء کو باقاعدہ سونے کے علاوہ کئی غیر معمولی ٹاسک اور چیلنجز بھی دیے جاتے تھے۔

فائنل مرحلے میں کارکردگی کی بنیاد پر جینیا چیٹرجی کو فاتح قرار دیا گیا اور انہیں 9 لاکھ 63 ہزار 400 بھارتی روپے نقد دیے گئے جو پاکستانی کرنسی میں 28 لاکھ روپے سے زائد بنتے ہیں۔ یاد رہے کہ یہ مقابلہ پہلی بار 2019 میں شروع کیا گیا تھا جس کے اب تک چار سیزنز ہو چکے ہیں۔

stories.title: China October Soybean Imports Drop to Lowest Level Since 2023
stories.summary:
China imported 7.35 million metric tons of soybeans in October, marking a 22.5% decline compared to the record 9.48 million tons imported during the same period last year and a 38% drop from September. According to customs data released on Tuesday, this brought the total arrivals for the world's biggest soybean buyer from January to October to 93.48 million tons, which is 2.3% lower than the previous year. Analysts explained that the low import volume—falling well short of fourth-quarter expectations of around 9.5 million tons per month—was driven by high crusher inventories, negative crushing margins, and low pork prices. Additionally, South American old-crop supplies were running out while bulk shipments of new-crop US soybeans had yet to begin.

Liu Jinlu, an agriculture researcher at Guoyan Futures based in Beijing, noted that any recovery in November and December imports will depend on China-US trade relations and improved crushing margins. Key risks include US weather disruptions, slower export shipments, and uncertain South American planting weather. Furthermore, private Chinese processors are confronting a costly fourth-quarter supply squeeze due to tightening inventories in Brazil and tariffs keeping US cargoes mostly out of reach. Meanwhile, Beijing's efforts to stabilize the oversupplied market are expected to contract the pig herd, creating a cloudy outlook for future feed demand. The country's breeding sow inventory stood at 36.02 million at the end of September, representing a 10.7% decrease over three months, as reported by the national statistics bureau in late October.

stories.title: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to Attend COP31 Climate Summit in Antalya
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is scheduled to visit Antalya, Turkey, from November 10 to November 12 to participate in the Leaders’ Summit of the 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). According to the Foreign Office, the premier will address the summit on November 11 to urge global action against the climate crisis. During his address, he will highlight Pakistan's initiatives toward rapid solarization, the expansion of renewable energy capacity, and efforts to strengthen disaster preparedness and early-warning systems. He will also advocate for predictable, adequate, and accessible climate finance for developing nations to enhance resilience and sustainable development.

On the sidelines of the summit, Prime Minister Sharif is slated to attend a high-level roundtable meeting convened by the COP31 presidency and hold bilateral discussions with Turkish leadership and other world leaders. His attendance underscores Pakistan's strong support for the international climate agenda and commitment to addressing the ongoing crisis. Meanwhile, the COP31 talks commenced in Antalya following a delayed opening ceremony amid intense negotiations over climate finance. Developing nations pushed for agenda items addressing funding mechanisms, while wealthy nations faced scrutiny over insufficient financial support and resistance from officials regarding additional funding pledges amid broader geopolitical tensions and economic challenges.

stories.title: Copper Prices Rise as Easing Oil and Tech Stock Rebound Boost Sentiment
stories.summary:
Copper prices ticked higher on Tuesday, supported by easing oil prices, a broader rebound in global technology stocks, and ongoing supply tightness within China. Benchmark three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange (LME) rose 0.31% to $13,939 a metric ton by 0300 GMT, while the most-traded copper contract on the Shanghai Futures Exchange (SHFE) increased by 0.14% to 107,700 yuan ($16,140) a ton. Buyers in China, the world's largest consumer, continue to face record premiums amid shortfalls in both copper concentrate and refined copper stocks. Data released on Tuesday showed that China's October copper concentrate imports dropped 11% year-on-year due to deep negative treatment charges and falling sulfuric acid prices squeezing smelters.

Underlying support was further reinforced by tight inventories, with copper stocks in SHFE-monitored warehouses resting at just 33,848 tons on Friday and the Yangshan premium climbing to a record $230 a ton on Monday. Broad rallies across Wall Street and global stock indices helped lift risk appetite, driven by a recovery in technology stocks following the post-midterm election selloff. According to Daniel Hynes, a senior commodity strategist at ANZ, hopes of a de-escalation in the Middle East conflict also pushed oil prices lower, improving overall market sentiment. This followed a more conciliatory tone regarding Iran by US President Donald Trump after the Republican Party's midterm setbacks, helping alleviate economic growth concerns that previously weighed on industrial metals like copper.

stories.title: بچوں کو ذہین اور پُراعتماد بنانے کے مؤثر طریقے
stories.summary:
ماہرین کے مطابق والدین کی توجہ، مثبت ماحول اور روزمرہ کی چند آسان عادتیں بچوں کو ذہین، سمجھ دار اور پُراعتماد بنانے میں اہم کردار ادا کرتی ہیں۔ بچوں کی بہترین ذہنی نشوونما کے لیے ان کے جذبات کو سمجھنا اور انہیں اپنے احساسات کھل کر بیان کرنے کی اجازت دینا ضروری ہے۔

بچوں کو ہر مشکل کا فوری حل بتانے کے بجائے خود سوچنے اور فیصلے کرنے کا موقع دیا جائے۔ غلطیوں پر ڈانٹنے کے بجائے ان سے سیکھنے کی ترغیب دی جائے، جبکہ خاندانی اور بورڈ گیمز جیسی تفریحی سرگرمیوں کو بڑھایا جائے۔ اس کے علاوہ روزانہ جسمانی کھیل کود اور ورزش بھی ان کی صحت کے لیے مفید ہیں۔

بچوں کو کھیلوں اور پڑھائی میں صحت مندانہ مقابلے کی عادت ڈالیں مگر جیتنے کا غیرضروری دباؤ ہرگز نہ ڈالیں۔ عمر کے لحاظ سے انہیں چھوٹی ذمہ داریاں سونپ کر خودمختاری دیں اور زندگی کی چھوٹی خوشیوں پر شکرگزاری کی عادت اپنانے کی تلقین کریں۔

stories.title: China and Hong Kong Shares Rise as Tech Stocks Track Wall Street Rally
stories.summary:
Stocks in China and Hong Kong advanced on Tuesday, propelled by artificial intelligence supply chain shares, as an overnight equity rally on Wall Street and falling oil prices improved risk sentiment across Asia. By the lunch break, China's blue-chip CSI300 Index and the Shanghai Composite Index both edged up by 0.1%, while Hong Kong's benchmark Hang Seng Index gained 0.2%. Asian chip supply chain equities tracked the Nasdaq's 2.7% jump, with onshore gains led by the 5G Communication Index rising 2.7% and the tech-focused STAR50 Index climbing 1%. Additionally, Hong Kong-listed shares of optical communication giant Zhongji Innolight surged 10%, and tech majors in the city added 0.5%.

Biotechnology firm Wuxi AppTec saw its shares rise as much as 5% before trimming gains after the Pentagon removed the company from its list of Chinese military enterprises. Meanwhile, non-ferrous metal shares increased by 0.5% as gold prices rebounded on lower oil prices, whereas the CSI Energy Index dropped 2.2%, with PetroChina declining 5.2%. China's trade surplus surpassed $1 trillion during the first 10 months of the year, driven by a global race to build AI infrastructure that boosted high-tech product sales and offset weak domestic demand, a trend expected to heighten tensions with trading partners. Separately, Chinese chip companies Suzhou Denglin Technology and Jiangsu Xinde Semiconductor Technology experienced mixed trading debuts in Hong Kong on Tuesday after raising a combined HK$2.36 billion ($301 million) through initial public offerings.

stories.title: کراچی پیسہ کماتا ہے مگر وفاق سے کیا ملتا ہے، مرتضیٰ وہاب
stories.summary:
